Complementary mechanisms, including social norms and contextual factors highlighted by Haugh & Talwar (2014) and Banerjee & Jackson (2016), help explain why mere financial support can crowd in economic benefits but generate mixed outcomes for empowerment and risk of indebtedness in some settings {{cite:S3#c1}} {{cite:S5#c1}}.
